rationale: Independent inspection of pages B788-B789 confirms the cited scaling scheme, theta formula, endpoint conventions, and distinction between exact scaling and later conversion. Unfolding every supplied dependency shows that the Lean target uses the finite maximum absolute component, integer dyadic powers, a global theta=min(fmax,sqrt(Fmax/n)), a row-dependent dyadic bracket, and exact diagonal scaling. Its entrywise upper bound and attained lower bound are equivalent to theta/2<||lambda x||_infinity<=theta. The explicit nonzero-row and positive-dimension assumptions repair necessities left implicit by the paper. The row-only scope is an acceptable specialization of equation (3.4a), so both semantic implications hold.
